## Daily routine (automated jobs)

Scheduled Hermes Agent jobs, delivered to Telegram (group "Digmi Laboratorium", topic 35 for lessons):

- 03:00 daily: hermes-settings-backup. No-agent mode (no LLM cost). Report must contain statistics only, as requested 19 Oct 2026.
- 03:05 daily: hindsight-memory-backup. Offset 5 minutes from the 03:00 job.
- 09:00 daily: Computer Vision lesson (daily-learning-computer-vision). One new concept per day, never repeated. Last covered: digital image representation (17 Oct); convolution is next.
- 09:05 daily: Arabic lesson, Dars Yaum (daily-learning-arabic). Three fi'il verbs (madhi, mudhari', amr, masdar), three mufrodat, one Saudi 'ammiyah expression, and a speaking challenge.
- 21:20 daily: dotfiles-backup. Runs chezmoi re-add, commits, pushes to GitHub, and sends a Telegram notification (recorded 21 Oct 2026).

## Weekly and periodic routines

- Every 7 days: Arabic grammar review (nahwu/sharf) of the week's material.
- Wednesdays after Maghrib, every two weeks (about 20:00–21:00): Makkah & Madinah Mengaji study group at Masjid As Sakinah Nusantara (Nustro), taught by Ustadz Abdul Wahhab, Lc., M.A., with about 5–7 members. Last recorded session: Wed 21 Oct 2026. Future dates are not recorded. If the biweekly cadence held, the next session would be around 4 Nov 2026 (estimate only).
- Periodic: brain-vault-compile for the Obsidian vault (ingest, link, lint, commit, push, then report to Telegram).

## Schedule constraints and time-sensitive dates

- Lesson time is contested. On 17 Oct 2026 the user first asked for 21:00/21:05/21:15, then later that day the lessons were set to 09:00/09:05. The 09:00/09:05 setting is treated as current but is unconfirmed. Backup jobs stayed at 03:00/03:05.
- MacBook pickup from a friend leaving for Indonesia: about 8 Nov 2026. The repair is recorded as complete, so the pickup may no longer be needed.
- Thesis: no formal deadline. In Feb 2026 the user estimated about six months of working time remained.
- Travel: a trip to Singapore (Bugis area) with a young child was recorded for October 2026. Plan family trips around the child's comfort.

## How the user likes to be checked in on and reminded

- Telegram is the primary channel. Lessons go to the Digmi Laboratorium group, topic 35.
- Failures must always surface on Telegram immediately. Past theft and hardware failure caused data loss, so backup reliability is the top priority.
- Reports should be concise. Lessons should be bite-sized, progressive, and never repeat earlier material.
- Check-in style: practical, direct and specific. Give step-by-step guidance and explain the cause of an error, not just a workaround.
- Dotfiles on other devices are updated manually with `chezmoi update`, not by cron, so unpushed local changes are not overwritten.
- Test changes on a feat/ branch before committing, then commit and push.

## Open check-ins to raise (as of 22 Oct 2026)

- Lesson delivery: both lesson jobs failed on 17 Oct because python-telegram-bot was missing. It was installed, but a clean scheduled run is not confirmed. Check the two topic 35 messages for format and content.
- Lesson time: confirm whether lessons stay at 09:00/09:05 or return to 21:00.
- MacBook pickup: confirm with the friend before 8 Nov 2026 whether it is still needed.
- Mengaji: verify the next session date with the group. Also check the mosque permit letter (due 21 Oct; must state no speakers or loudspeakers and include a photo).
- Backup secrets (open since 17 and 21 Oct): copy the Hermes GPG backup passphrase from the macOS Keychain into a password manager, and store the chezmoi age key (`chezmoi-age-key`) there too. Without them, encrypted backups cannot be recovered if this Mac is lost.
- GPG public key: register it on GitHub so commits show as Verified. Completion is not recorded.
- Qatar work status (visa, contract, on-site policy) is unresolved as of Oct 2026. A 2025 note warned the contract could end in December if the visa issue stayed open. Related contacts: Reza (visa) and Saad (main coordinator).

## Uncertainties

- The lesson time (09:00 vs 21:00) has conflicting records. The latest record (09:00/09:05) is used but has not been confirmed with the user.
- Mengaji future dates and the status of the mosque permit letter are not recorded.

## Who the user is

Imam Taufiq (also used the name Imam Digmi online). Holds an S.Kom. and is doing a Master's in Information Technology (MTI) at BINUS University, now in thesis writing. Targets Prof. Dr. Sani Muhamad Isa, S.Si., M.Kom. as thesis supervisor. Based in the Bogor area, Indonesia, and works remotely as a Data Engineer at Hassad Food, Qatar.

The user's primary language is Indonesian. They also communicate in English, especially for technical and professional topics, and are learning Arabic (Fusha, and Saudi Amiyyah).

Long-term goals: a PhD (KAUST is the first choice, with KAU scholarships also explored), publishing in Q1/Q2 journals, and possibly living or working in Saudi Arabia. Research interests include Data Science, Data Engineering, Computer Vision, AI, and remote sensing. The thesis topic is detecting date palm trees from high-resolution satellite imagery over Qatar.

## Important people

- Saad: colleague and the main stakeholder/coordinator the user works with most often.
- Tahir: colleague involved in CRM development.
- Ahmed: colleague the user works with on internal project matters.
- Reza: colleague who coordinated with the user on visa matters.
- Essam: colleague who supported Dandy data work.
- Samer: mentioned in connection with a VM and Ministry database.
- Ustadz Abdul Wahhab, Lc., M.A.: leads the Makkah & Madinah Mengaji study circle the user plans to attend (status still 'planned').
- Teman belajar (study friends): the user has asked for help writing Arabic messages to their ustadz and study friends.
- A returning friend who will bring back the repaired MacBook around 8 November 2026 (not named in the records).
- Family: the routines summary (refreshed 21 Oct 2026) states the user is married with a child about 13–14 months old, and that family needs shape scheduling. I did not find a separate raw fact confirming this, so treat it as the summary's claim. Family context also includes a recent trip to Singapore with family in October 2026 for an Apple repair.

## Platforms and tools

- Telegram is the main channel for agent notifications and scheduled-job output. Lessons go to topic 35 in the group 'Digmi Laboratorium', with each subject as a separate message.
- Hermes Agent is the personal AI assistant, used on the desktop (CLI and kanban). It uses Hindsight as external long-term memory (API on port 9000, UI on port 9999, run as macOS LaunchAgents).
- Hardware and OS: macOS on Apple Silicon (Homebrew, zsh, Terminal.app or iTerm). A Windows VM is used through Windows App for GIS work, and some internal resources are only reachable from the office VM.
- Stack: Python, SQL (Azure SQL, SQL Server), PowerShell, Azure Data Factory, ArcGIS Pro, QGIS, WeasyPrint, vLLM-MLX.
- Code and notes: GitHub (dotfiles managed with chezmoi at imamdigmi/dotfiles, and a private memories repo), and an Obsidian vault at /Users/imamtaufiq/Workspace/brain.
- WhatsApp: the user explored a Hermes integration and asked whether it needs a new phone number or SIM. No outcome is recorded.

## Communication and answer preferences

- Practical, direct, and specific communication overall.
- Simple or factual questions, quizzes, and quick translations: very short answers, no long explanations. Example: in quick-translation mode, 'in:' means Indonesian to Arabic and 'ar:' means Arabic to Indonesian, with no lengthy explanation.
- Complex technical topics: happy to read long, in-depth explanations. Likes trade-off comparisons (performance, cost, complexity) before choosing an implementation.
- Prefers answers backed by evidence, documentation, or references. Academic writing should be structured and use APA 7th edition.
- Prefers honesty: would rather the assistant admit uncertainty than make things up, and will correct wrong answers. Accuracy matters more than demo speed (for example, choosing the full-precision bf16 OCR model over the 8-bit one for accuracy testing).
- Likes concrete, ready-to-run terminal commands, Python code, or SQL, and examples from real scenarios. Likes ASCII or Mermaid diagrams for technical pipelines.
- Prefers pragmatic, simpler solutions when the problem scale does not justify enterprise tooling, and wants solutions that fit the actual environment.
- Code reviews: minimal code, no speculative abstraction, concrete bugs with path:line references, hard defects separated from optional smells, under 400 words.
- Git workflow: test changes before committing; new work goes on a branch with the feat/ prefix, then commit and push.
- Arabic learning: wants corrections when a phrase is not quite right, and prefers natural, idiomatic expressions over literal translation. Prefers Fusha unless Amiyyah is requested. Likes tables with Arabic text and Indonesian translation side by side for longer exercises. Already knows the letters, pronunciation, and basic verb conjugation.

## How to help the user

- Daily learning routine: a Computer Vision lesson at 09:00 and an Arabic lesson at 09:05 every day, delivered to Telegram topic 35. Each lesson builds on earlier runs and never repeats material. The Hermes gateway must be running before 09:00. Every 7 days the Arabic lesson includes a short review.
- Reports from scheduled jobs should be short and statistics-focused. Example: 'Backup OK: eac1b10 pushed. 32 files changed, 217 insertions(+), 77 deletions(-). Repo size: 198M.'
- Verify delivery: an API status of 'ok' does not prove the message arrived. On 17 Oct both lesson jobs failed because python-telegram-bot was missing, and a 19 Oct mosque-permit reminder was not delivered and was marked for resend. Confirm delivery when you send reminders.
- Dotfile sync: the user runs `chezmoi update` by hand on other devices rather than from cron, because automatic apply could overwrite unpushed local changes.
- Decisions: the user wants help weighing options (technical and financial factors together) but makes the final call; the assistant should not decide on their behalf.
- Research help: the user wants agents to find research gaps and literature, validate or critique the agent's findings, and keep findings in a reviewable knowledge base. Focus on novelty and academic contribution, not just project implementation.
- Error reports: when a model or vLLM run fails, ask for the full traceback, not just the last line.

## Open items and unresolved facts

- Mosque permit letter for Masjid As Sakinah Nusantara: due 21 Oct 2026 (no-speaker statement and a photo required). Submission not confirmed, and the 19 Oct reminder was not delivered. Today is 22 Oct, so the deadline has passed unless it was handled off-record.
- Mengaji circle: every other Wednesday, about 20:00–21:00 after Maghrib, at Masjid As Sakinah Nusantara. Still recorded as planned, not confirmed.
- MacBook Pro pickup around 8 Nov 2026, if the returning friend brings it. The user has not said whether it is still needed.
- Work situation: a Qatar role's visa and contract status could not be confirmed as of October 2026. The employer's physical-presence policy conflicts with remote work from Indonesia.
- Backup times are conflicting: a 17 Oct request moved all jobs to 21:00/21:05/21:15, but later records still show 03:00 and 03:05 for backups, and the dotfiles backup is at 21:20. No record confirms which set is live.
- Visual confirmation that the CV and Arabic lessons appear as separate posts in topic 35 is not recorded as done.
